name: European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
disclaimer: Academic reference and mapping crosswalk for EU AI Act provisions. The platform is an assessment aid and does not constitute formal legal counsel or regulatory certification.

controls.title: Risk Management System (Article 9)
controls.description: Establish, implement, document, and maintain a continuous risk management system throughout the entire lifecycle of high-risk AI systems.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify systematic identification and evaluation of risks to health, safety, and fundamental rights, and documented mitigations.

controls.title: Data and Data Governance (Article 10)
controls.description: Training, validation, and testing datasets shall be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices, preventing biases and unauthorized exposure.
controls.verification_guidance: Examine provenance tracking for training/RAG documents, bias checks, and privacy protection protocols.

controls.title: Transparency and Provision of Information to Deployers (Article 13)
controls.description: AI systems must be designed to ensure sufficient transparency to enable deployers to interpret outputs and use the system appropriately.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify documentation of system capabilities, limitations, model versions, citation sources, and confidence metrics.

controls.title: Human Oversight (Article 14)
controls.description: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed so that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period they are in use.
controls.verification_guidance: Check for human-in-the-loop approval gates for autonomous agent actions, stop buttons, and override controls.

controls.title: Accuracy, Robustness and Cybersecurity (Article 15)
controls.description: AI systems must achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, remaining resilient against third-party exploitation, prompt injection, and data poisoning.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify defensive guardrails against prompt injection, output sanitization, secret protection, and dependency vulnerability management.

controls.title: Transparency Obligations for Certain AI Systems (Article 50)
controls.description: Providers must ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons inform users that they are interacting with an AI system.
controls.verification_guidance: Check user interface and system responses for AI interaction disclaimers and synthetic content watermarking.
